blocks.text: Greenhouse effect woh qudrati amal hai jis mein zameen ki hawa (atmosphere) mein maujood gases zameen ki satah se nikalne wali garmi ko qaid (trap) kar leti hain. In gases ko Greenhouse Gases (GHGs) kehte hain. Yeh gases dhoop ko andar aane deti hain lekin garmi ko seedha wapas khala (space) mein jane se rokti hain. Is tarah yeh zameen ko itna garam rakhti hain ke us par zindagi qaim reh sake.

GHGs, khaas taur par CO₂, ki miqdar (concentration) mein wazeh izafa hua hai. Is ki bari wajah woh kaam hain jin mein fossil fuels (koyla, tel, gas) jalaye jate hain: machinein chalana, gaariyan chalana, ghar garam karna aur bijli banana. Zyada GHGs ki wajah se zameen ki hawa ka yeh barha hua, ghair qudrati garam hona hamare mahol par insani sargarmiyon ka sab se bara manfi (negative) asar hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Qudrati greenhouse effect achha hai: is ke baghair zameen bohat thandi hoti. Masla barha hua (enhanced) greenhouse effect hai, jo insanon ki chhori hui izafi GHGs se hota hai aur global warming laata hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar greenhouse effect bilkul na ho to zameen ka kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Garmi seedha khala mein chali jati aur zameen maujooda zindagi ke liye bohat thandi hoti; masla barha hua effect hai, qudrati nahi.

items: Greenhouse effect: GHGs dhoop ko andar aane deti hain lekin garmi ko khala mein jane se rokti hain; zameen zindagi ke liye garam rehti hai.
Fossil fuels jalane se GHGs, khaas kar CO₂, barh gayi hain; barha hua greenhouse effect insani sargarmiyon ka sab se bara manfi asar hai.
